nodes.label: Client-Side IndexedDB Persistence
nodes.rationale: Phase 1 app persists all state locally in the browser via IndexedDB (idb/kvGet/kvSet) instead of a server backend, letting the prototype run standalone while mirroring the original Google Sheets + Apps Script workflow without server infrastructure.
nodes.norm_label: client-side indexeddb persistence

nodes.label: Debounced Auto-Save
nodes.rationale: save() debounces kvSet writes by 400ms (via setTimeout) to avoid excessive IndexedDB writes on every keystroke while editing the transactions grid.
nodes.norm_label: debounced auto-save

nodes.label: Debounced Search/Filter Inputs
nodes.rationale: Search inputs across Data Entry, Payments, Companies and the generic simpleTable renderer debounce user input via setTimeout (~200-250ms) before re-rendering filtered results, trading a small delay for reduced re-render churn on large datasets (e.g. 2400+ payment rows).
nodes.norm_label: debounced search/filter inputs

nodes.label: Statement Generator Ported from Google Apps Script
nodes.rationale: Source comment explicitly labels this app as a port of 'data entry sheet + statement generator (Apps Script #1)'; buildStatement/companyEntries/drawStatement replicate the original Google Apps Script function generateStatementOnSheet's balance and opening-balance logic in client-side JavaScript.
nodes.norm_label: statement generator ported from google apps script

nodes.label: Cost vs Received Field Semantic Inversion
nodes.rationale: Inline comment in companyEntries clarifies that the transactions sheet's 'received' field represents what the customer OWES (mapped to 'cost' on the statement), while payments' 'amount' field is the actual money received — a naming inversion carried over from the original spreadsheet that could confuse future maintainers.
nodes.norm_label: cost vs received field semantic inversion

nodes.label: Phase 1 Read-Only Invoices / Phase 2 Roadmap
nodes.rationale: The Invoices view is explicitly read-only in Phase 1; an on-screen note states invoice creation, templates and PDF generation are planned for Phase 2.
nodes.norm_label: phase 1 read-only invoices / phase 2 roadmap

nodes.label: Incomplete Historical Data Import
nodes.rationale: The Data/Backup view notes only the FROM JAN 2026 sheet was imported; the NOV 24-JAN 25 and FROM FEB 2025 tabs referenced by the original Apps Script are missing, so pre-2026 statements will show payments without matching work rows until those tabs are supplied.
nodes.norm_label: incomplete historical data import
